name: Manastorm floor XP: a run without a max-level member still grants floor XP to its lower-level members
contract: Control for manastorm-floor-xp-max-level-carry. ManastormExperience::PrepareCompletion queues the repeatable
RDF 258 quest XP for every run member below MaxPlayerLevel on each completed floor, and ManastormProgression
settles it for online members right after the floor commits. With no member at MaxPlayerLevel (80 on this
realm), the level-56 member gains XP in the same update as the objective death, before the next floor's
teleport. The member holds Servant's Errand (192), whose SPELL_AURA_MOD_XP_PCT -100 covers only the kill XP
source, so the dungeon's group kill-XP share adds nothing and the gain is the floor reward alone.
